newsitem.title: USA: TransTexas expects higher cash flow in Q4.
newsitem.headline: TransTexas expects higher cash flow in Q4.

text.p: TransTexas Gas Corp said on Tuesday it estimated that cash flow in the fourth quarter would increase by about $20 million from an increase in gross natural gas production of 200 million cubic feet per day (MMcfd) expected before the end of November.
The company said in a statement the planned production increase will come from six additional natural gas wells that the company expects to commence production between Oct 29 and Nov 22.

President and chief operating officer Arnold Brackenridge said, "The ongoing development of (the Bob West North Field) will next month make this field the company's single largest natural gas-producing area.

"As a result, net company daily production beginning Dec. 1 should be in excess of 550 MMcfd. We are also currently realizing improved commodity pricing. Putting these factors together, it is reasonable to arrive at a fourth quarter cash flow improvement in the range of $20 million."
